svg.aria-label: One problem, a bookmark service, answered at three depths. Foundation: one API, one database, an ownership check, stable pagination and one justified index, answering whether it works and stays correct for the wrong user. Operating constraints adds consistency, overload, authorization, data access, recovery and rollout, answering what happens when it is busy and when a dependency dies. Broader ownership adds scope, compatibility, a migration path, who else it breaks and what it costs to reverse, answering whether you can change it without stopping the world.
svg.text: ONE PROBLEM. THE DEPTH IS IN THE FOLLOW-UPS.
